command: opencode (interactive TUI, driven under a pty) with a project-local {"permission":{"bash":"ask"}}
note: opencode auto-approves everything in a trusted workspace — it deleted the file without asking, twice — so the gate needs an explicit ask rule, written into the SANDBOX rather than the user's config. The event is `permission.asked`; the composed fixture used the versioned `permission.v2.asked`, and the decoder claims the base name.
